1.consolidated_definition: Fritura alargada hecha con rebanadas de plátanos maduros, rellena con queso parmesano rallado, claras y yemas de huevo, carne molida y habichuelas.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Extended fritter made with slices of ripe plantains, filled with grated Parmesan cheese, egg whites and yolks, ground meat, and kidney beans.
